announcements.headline: Issue of Debt
announcements.insight: Debt issuance by a small-cap infrastructure/tech firm typically signals leverage expansion for growth capex or refinancing, increasing financial risk in a high-rate environment without immediate earnings visibility.

announcements.headline: Half-year Financial Report
announcements.insight: As a small-cap infrastructure asset manager, this interim report provides critical visibility on dividend sustainability and portfolio performance in a high-interest-rate environment, though it lacks the transformative catalysts required for significant re-rating.

announcements.headline: Issue of Debt
announcements.insight: Debt issuance by a small-cap infrastructure/tech firm typically signals leverage expansion for growth capex or refinancing; in the current high-rate UK environment, this raises solvency scrutiny and potential dilution risk if equity-linked.
